title: Chicago North Side iNaturalist observations
licence: Each observation keeps its own licence (CC0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0); attribute "iNaturalist contributors". Non-commercial use.
note: Chicago North Side: 1 Rogers Park, 2 West Ridge, 3 Uptown, 4 Lincoln Square, 5 North Center, 6 Lake View, 7 Lincoln Park, 13 North Park, 14 Albany Park, 16 Irving Park, 21 Avondale, 22 Logan Square, 77 Edgewater. Kept 2344 of 23436 observations, every 10-th row starting at zero after sorting by time (source index breaks ties). day is zero-based day of 2023; hour is local wall-clock hour, without timezone conversion. tract indexes s2-chicago-north-tracts, or -1 outside that subset. Coordinates rounded to 5 decimals.
